items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: I used to go out and kind of oversee those residencies with the band director and she would just come in and work with any level of student that was there... I set the whole thing up

ctx.x: the school really knew who Marian McPartland was. But I remember thinking well even at this level she needs to make a living and she’s being part of this program that will send you to schools and so forth and it was a good lesson to learn.

Um hum. Yeah, she was a great ambassador for the music, we had her out to Connecticut, had her out here to Michigan, and she had an ongoing relationship with a high school out in Long Island and I used to go out and kind of oversee those residencies with the band director and she would just come in and work with any level of student that was there, she would play with them and she was just so gracious. One favorite McPartland story of mine is that she came out to the University of Michigan and the dean and…

Oh. Did she ever tell you about the time her uncle came from England, you know, an aristocratic type person and came to where she was playing. And he goes, “Margaret! Do your parents know what you’re doing here?” It was so funny the way she said it, you know like what are you doing in a bar.
